span.p:
+ FLEX SHIP compensation
where passed through

color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Every line traces to a specific order_item.
Nothing is derived from a spreadsheet
formula - the ledger IS the calculation.
This is what makes settlements auditable.

Carry debit balance
to next cycle

Paymob Send automation lands in Phase 2.
Money never moves on an automated
decision alone.

span.p:
Mark failed + alert finance
do NOT auto-retry

span.p:
Retrying a payout without an idempotency
key is how vendors get paid twice.
Failed payouts are always a human decision.
